FILING_DESTINATION.basis: Current route registry and extracted participant guidance against the exact source form roles.
FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Guidance tells the participant to file the 2025 Criminal Cover Sheet with the petition and file the Judicial Council arrest petition with the clerk of the district court. It identifies the post-order KBI cover sheet handoff and does not tell the participant to file it as the petition. Court notice, hearing and court-owned fields remain court controlled.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.basis: Current route registry fee rule and participant guidance.
FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Guidance states the $176 docket fee, the supreme-court charge not exceeding $19 per docket fee through June 30, 2030, the statutory (b)(3)(B) no-fee exemption categories, and that no discretionary waiver exists. It tells the participant to ask the clerk about the exemption and invents no waiver or amount. Current-form freshness remains a release gate in the adopted registry and is not silently resolved here.

SERVICE.basis: Current route registry and participant guidance.
SERVICE.finding: Guidance states that the court sets the hearing and causes notice to the prosecuting attorney and arresting law-enforcement agency, and expressly tells the participant not to serve them. It assigns hearing/date/time/courtroom/case number when unassigned, findings and signature to the court.

SELF_HELP_STOP.basis: Current participant guidance and adopted route self-help boundaries.
SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The packet directs the participant to stop self-help and obtain legal help for prosecutor opposition, a contested evidentiary hearing, a disputed ground, conviction or completed diversion, a city-ordinance arrest or immigration consequences. It preserves the arrest-only versus K.S.A. 21-6614 and municipal-route distinctions and does not decide eligibility.
